title: 黒き不純物の夜明けに、結晶の樹は泣く
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: At the Dawn of Black Impurities, the Crystalline Tree Weeps
en.premise: I abandoned my humanity to become an opal cherry tree, harboring Kiryu’s lingering regrets—black impurities—within my heart. My consciousness, which should have slept in the pinnacle of cold beauty, is fractured by the sound of frozen migratory birds flying past the window. A lukewarm pain I once rejected begins to throb inside branches as hard as an ice castle, and I feel myself being torn once more from this paradise of stillness.

zh.title: 在黑色不纯物的黎明，结晶之树在哭泣
zh.premise: 我舍弃了身为人类的身份，成为了心房中寄宿着桐生之执念（黑色不纯物）的欧泊樱树。本应在极致的冰冷之美中沉睡的意识，却被窗外飞过的冻结候鸟的振翅声撕开了一道裂痕。曾经被我拒绝的、那温热的痛楚，开始在如冰城般坚硬的枝干内部隐隐作痛。我正被再次从这静止的乐园中撕裂而出。
